title_pattern: At least one sev1 or sev2 release-related incident in {{period}}?
event_definition_pattern: incident.io records at least one incident created in {{period}} ({{period_start}} to {{period_end}}) whose normalized severity is sev1 or sev2 and that the knowledge rules classify as release_related.

title_pattern: Release-related incidents per deploy in {{period}} below {{param.x}}?
event_definition_pattern: In {{period}}, the count of release-related incidents divided by the count of deploys is less than {{param.x}}.
